NAME:
   rancher auth get-token - Authenticate and print a kubeconfig ExecCredential

USAGE:
   rancher auth get-token [flags]

FLAGS:
   --auth-flow flow      identity-provider flow
   --auth-provider name  auth config name to sign in with (for example corp-ldap); with --user-id it must be the auth config's exact name, and only tokens made through it are used; without --user-id a provider name or type such as openldap also works, and with several matches the CLI asks, or lists them in the error
   --cacert path         PEM CA bundle, a path or the literal PEM
   --cluster id|name     cluster id|name to create the exec-credential token for; required unless --user-id is given
   --help, -h            show help
   --name name           stored server name to use
   --server url          Rancher server url
   --user-id id          Rancher user id the token must belong to; with it, --cluster may be omitted for a token for Rancher itself

GLOBAL FLAGS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
